theme: Held-source face, lexical and candidate reviews integrated into the object register
question: Which layout, lexical-source and candidate identity or exposure gaps can the held evidence close, and can those reviews be integrated without changing frozen source records?
outcome: Reviewed 29 faces with two sealed visual records; accepted 21 provisional spatial layouts and 12 source-segment maps. Integrated 24 lexical-form reviews, 40 frozen compound sample cases and 3 diagnostics, plus all 358 candidate identity/exposure reviews. Reverified 24 existing identifier links; 306 candidate-only and 28 unlinked remain. Preserved 4695 object families and 5680 faces, adding 5474 review assertions including 5396 unresolved candidate relations. No new physical merges, authenticated readings or fresh confirmation objects.
challenge: Image tiers and catalogue segments differ; exact dictionary forms can select wrong senses or languages; page access does not establish exact object exposure. The first integration reused a path variable and produced incorrect compact face-review links.
remedy: Kept independent visual freezes, source-qualified decisions, scoped lexical relations and participant/page uncertainty. Preserved the first integration and its code, reproduced the provenance bug in a regression test, and built a corrected run-v2.
retry_when: Obtain expert layout and lexical reviews, stronger catalogue or accession identities, original source-page mappings and participant-specific exposure evidence; complete corrected lexical extraction and calibrated controls.

authors.model: GPT-6 family; exact backend identifier not exposed
